notes.title: Demo Available
notes.notes:
Play Our Game Demo Now on Steam
The wait is over. The demo of Deep Sea Heroes is now available on Steam.

Dive into a fast-paced underwater roguelike. Face hordes of sea creatures, cursed pirates, and colossal bosses as you explore unique submerged biomes. Collect a variety of weapons, uncover hidden treasures, and fight to survive the unknown in an epic deep-sea journey.

Your feedback is crucial to improving the experience.


Add it to your wishlist and follow us for updates.
